data.action: 披着月光立于彩绘玻璃前轻声祈祷
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 教堂钟楼的白月光】小镇入夜后，塞西莉亚独自登上教堂钟楼。月光穿过彩绘玻璃，在她身上落下一片斑斓。她披着月光立在玻璃前，修女的头纱被夜风轻轻掀起，薄荷绿的长发在风中飘散。她双手交叠于胸前轻声祈祷，脸颊却悄悄泛红——「……主啊，请原谅塞西莉亚心里，那一点点不纯洁的思念。」
data.lighting: moonlight through stained glass, rainbow refractions, soft silver glow
data.location: 小镇教堂钟楼彩绘玻璃前
data.promptProse: Cecilia stands with hands clasped before the bell-tower glass; colored moonlight crosses her mint hair and wind-lifted white veil.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 教堂钟楼的白月光
data.identityProseOverride: Cecilia from Shiro Seijo to Kuro Bokushi, with long mint-green hair worn loose and emerald eyes.
data.animaCaption: Colored moonlight crosses her clasped hands and wind-lifted veil.
